title: Export plots in low and high resolution

cues.en: I'm going to show you two things in this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片要示範兩件事。

cues.en: One is how to create higher resolution images in the notebook here visually.
cues.zh: 第一，如何讓這裡筆記本的影像，在視覺上具有更高解析度；

cues.en: And two, how to download images to your computer.
cues.zh: 第二，如何把影像下載到電腦。

cues.en: Because here we are working on a remote server on Google's Google Collapse remote server.
cues.zh: 因為我們現在是在遠端伺服器上工作，也就是 Google Colab 的遠端伺服器。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So to start with, I'm just going to create some data.
cues.zh: 首先建立一些資料，

cues.en: There's just something for us to plot so linearly space numbers between point five and five and there's going to be ten of them.
cues.zh: 只是拿來繪圖的內容，0.5 到 5 之間的等距數字，共十個。

cues.en: And then I'm going to say why one equals the log of X and Y two equals two minus the square root of
cues.zh: 然後說 y1 等於 log(x)，y2 等於 2 減 x 的平方根，

cues.en: x.
cues.zh: x 的平方根。

cues.en: Again, you know, there's nothing particularly universally amazing about these two functions.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這兩個函數並沒有什麼普遍而驚人的意義，

cues.en: I just think that they look nice on the plot that we are about to generate.
cues.zh: 只是覺得在即將產生的圖上，它們看起來不錯。

cues.en: Okay, so plt plot x comma y one and plt plot x comma y two and plt show.
cues.zh: 好，plt.plot(x,y1)、plt.plot(x,y2)，以及 plt.show。

cues.en: Let's see what this looks like.
cues.zh: 看看長什麼樣。

cues.en: So here we see the log function, and here we see the square root, and then it's just minus the square root.
cues.zh: 這裡看到對數函數，這裡看到平方根，再來其實是減去平方根。

cues.en: Okay, Now I'm just going to make these plots look a little bit nicer.
cues.zh: 現在把這些圖稍微美化一下。

cues.en: I'm going to set this one to be blue circles with a line or I should say blue line with circles at the marker values that all of the coordinates and this one is going to be red squares.
cues.zh: 這個設成有線的藍色圓圈，或者應該說，藍色線在所有座標的標記位置加上圓圈，這個則是紅色正方形。

cues.en: And then I'll also set a label.
cues.zh: 也設定標籤，

cues.en: This was the square root and this one was the log.
cues.zh: 這是平方根，這是對數。

cues.en: And now, of course, we need to add plot legend.
cues.zh: 當然，需要加入 plt.legend。

cues.en: And now you see.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，

cues.en: Okay, so I think this looks a little bit nicer than it looked before.
cues.zh: 我覺得這比之前好看一些。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now notice that it's a little bit grainy.
cues.zh: 注意，它有點顆粒感，

cues.en: It's a little bit pixilated.
cues.zh: 有點像素化。

cues.en: Maybe you can see this better on your screen than on my screen.
cues.zh: 也許你在自己的螢幕上，比我這裡更容易看出來。

cues.en: Let's see.
cues.zh: 看看，

cues.en: I'll zoom in here.
cues.zh: 我把這裡放大。

cues.en: You can see notice the difference between this text here, which is drawn at sort of as we zoom in, we continue to get good resolution.
cues.zh: 注意這裡文字的差異，文字隨著放大，仍然維持良好解析度。

cues.en: This image here, on the other hand, is pixilated.
cues.zh: 但這裡的影像像素化了，

cues.en: So you can see that the more I zoom in, the worse it looks.
cues.zh: 可以看到，越放大，看起來越差。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what I am going to do now is modify the map plot lib defaults to draw this as an SVG, which is a
cues.zh: 現在要修改 matplotlib 的預設值，讓它畫成 SVG，也就是

cues.en: vector based graphics instead of a JPEG, which is a pixel based graphics.
cues.zh: 向量圖，而不是 JPEG 這類像素圖。

cues.en: So to do that, I'm going to go back up here to the top cell of the code file of the notebook where
cues.zh: 為此，回到筆記本程式檔最上面的儲存格，

cues.en: we specify all of the libraries and I will write from I python import display.
cues.zh: 也就是指定所有函式庫的地方，寫 from IPython import display。

cues.en: This should be import like this notice here.
cues.zh: 這裡應該寫 import，像這樣。注意，

cues.en: So I python is the general name for these notebooks.
cues.zh: IPython 是這類筆記本的通用名稱，

cues.en: And then google kind of adopted the python notebook for their preferences.
cues.zh: Google 再依照自己的偏好，採用了 Python 筆記本。

cues.en: But this is called an I python notebook.
cues.zh: 但這叫做 IPython notebook，

cues.en: The AI is for interactive.
cues.zh: I 代表 interactive，也就是互動式。

cues.en: Now, one thing that I often get messages from from students is that they say that this doesn't work.
cues.zh: 我常收到學生訊息，說這段不能用，

cues.en: This gives them an error.
cues.zh: 會出錯。

cues.en: And almost every basically every time that I that students complain about this, giving them an error, it's an error of capitalization.
cues.zh: 幾乎每次學生抱怨這裡出錯，都是大小寫的問題。

cues.en: So this is Capital I, capital P, python.
cues.zh: 所以是大寫 I、大寫 P，再接 ython。

cues.en: So I Python with two capitals import display and then I'm going to set the display dot set, match,
cues.zh: IPython 有兩個大寫字母，import display，接著設定 display.set_matplotlib_formats，

cues.en: plot, lib, underscore formats.
cues.zh: set_matplotlib_formats。

cues.en: And then here I write SVG svg like this.
cues.zh: 這裡寫 svg，像這樣，svg。

cues.en: Now I'm going to run this code.
cues.zh: 現在執行程式碼，

cues.en: So this is changing the map plot lib format to be vector graphics instead of pixel graphics, and that's using the python display function.
cues.zh: 這就會把 matplotlib 的格式改成向量圖，而不是像素圖，用的是 IPython 的 display 功能。

cues.en: Now I'm going to copy this code and paste it down here because I don't want to rerun this cell again that's going to overwrite this plot.
cues.zh: 現在複製這段程式碼，貼到下面，因為不想重新執行這個儲存格，覆蓋掉這張圖。

cues.en: Instead, I'm going to generate a new plot so we can compare this against the previous one.
cues.zh: 我要產生新圖，才能和之前的比較。

cues.en: So remember here we zoomed in and it started looking ugly and pixilated.
cues.zh: 記得，這裡一放大，就開始變醜、變得像素化，

cues.en: Here I can zoom in and now this.
cues.zh: 這裡可以放大，現在這個，

cues.en: This is not generated by pixel graphics, this is generated by vector graphics.
cues.zh: 不是用像素圖產生，而是用向量圖產生。

cues.en: So it doesn't matter how much I zoom in, this is still going to look really nice.
cues.zh: 所以不管放大多少，看起來都還是很好。

cues.en: You will see very, very often in the the rest of this course, I have these two lines of code, probably not in every video, but in fact, I think if I don't have this line of code, it's probably because
cues.zh: 在這門課其餘內容，會經常看到這兩行程式碼，也許不是每支影片都有，但其實如果沒有這行，可能只是因為

cues.en: I was lazy or I forgot.
cues.zh: 我懶了，或忘記了。

cues.en: So most of the time when I am generating graphics in Python, I add these two lines of code and that just makes the graphs look nicer and crisper.
cues.zh: 所以大部分時候，在 Python 產生圖形，我都會加這兩行，讓圖更漂亮、更清晰。

cues.en: Okay, now how do you get this picture to your computer?
cues.zh: 好，怎麼把這張圖片放到你的電腦？

cues.en: This is a picture in this notebook that is run on a Google server somewhere.
cues.zh: 這是這個筆記本裡的一張圖片，筆記本在某個 Google 伺服器上執行，

cues.en: I have no idea where these server computers are.
cues.zh: 我也不知道這些伺服器電腦在哪裡。

cues.en: Now, one way to do this would be to you could take a screenshot and and just take grab this from a screenshot and then paste it into some other program.
cues.zh: 一種方式是截圖，直接從螢幕截圖取得它，再貼到其他程式。

cues.en: That's totally fine.
cues.zh: 完全可以，

cues.en: There's nothing wrong with that.
cues.zh: 這沒有什麼問題。

cues.en: But there's also another way that you can do this by writing plt Save Fig.
cues.zh: 不過還有另一種方式，就是寫 plt.savefig，

cues.en: So save the figure and let's call this test dot P and G.
cues.zh: 儲存圖形，把它叫做 test.png。

cues.en: So now I run this code and it doesn't really look like much happened here.
cues.zh: 執行後，看起來沒有發生多少事情，

cues.en: It didn't download any files.
cues.zh: 沒有下載任何檔案，

cues.en: We don't see where we didn't get some pop up window to save this file.
cues.zh: 也沒有跳出儲存檔案的視窗。

cues.en: In fact, what Python did here is save this file locally, but locally means in the remote server and that if you look here on the left, you can see a couple of menu options.
cues.zh: 其實 Python 把檔案存在本機，但這裡的本機是遠端伺服器。看看左邊，可以看到幾個選單選項。

cues.en: I'll show you more about what to do with these things throughout the course as they become relevant.
cues.zh: 隨著課程遇到相關情境，我會再多介紹這些功能。

cues.en: But for now, you can click on this file, this little folder icon, open that up and this shows you the local files that we have on the remote server.
cues.zh: 現在只要點這個檔案、這個小資料夾圖示，打開後就會顯示遠端伺服器上的本機檔案。

cues.en: So here is the file that we just created.
cues.zh: 這就是剛才建立的檔案，

cues.en: You can actually double click on this.
cues.zh: 其實可以按兩下，

cues.en: It's going to open it up in its own window here.
cues.zh: 它會在這裡自己的視窗開啟。

cues.en: And actually I just now see what I did here.
cues.zh: 其實我現在才看到，剛才這裡做了什麼，

cues.en: So this save thing, this actually needs to go before PLT show.
cues.zh: 這個 savefig，其實需要放在 plt.show 之前。

cues.en: Remember I explained several videos ago that every time you run PLT show, that kind of closes off the figure and everything before PLT show is associated with the current figure.
cues.zh: 記得幾支影片前解釋過，每次執行 plt.show，有點像結束圖形，而 plt.show 之前的內容都關聯到目前的圖。

cues.en: So let's run this code again.
cues.zh: 再執行一次。

cues.en: And now.
cues.zh: 現在，

cues.en: Yeah, now we double click on test PNG and now you can see it just opened up that file over here.
cues.zh: 對，按兩下 test.png，就看到它在這裡開啟了檔案。

cues.en: Now this is actually just a viewer.
cues.zh: 這其實只是檢視器，

cues.en: We still don't have this file actually downloaded on our computer.
cues.zh: 檔案還沒有真的下載到我們的電腦。

cues.en: So how do we download this?
cues.zh: 該怎麼下載？

cues.en: Well, you can click on this little optional menu button here and say, Download.
cues.zh: 可以點這個小選項按鈕，再選 Download，

cues.en: That's fine.
cues.zh: 這樣可以，

cues.en: It's a manual way to do it.
cues.zh: 是手動的做法。

cues.en: I'm going to show you another way to download this file.
cues.zh: 我要再示範另一種下載檔案的方式，

cues.en: And that's done using a library from Google.
cues.zh: 使用 Google 的函式庫。

cues.en: So from Google Echo Lab import files and yeah, no, I guess I keep saying that you should put these
cues.zh: 所以 from google.colab import files。對，我一直說應該把

cues.en: library import lines up at the top of the code, but, well, for now, I will just leave it right here.
cues.zh: 函式庫匯入放在程式碼最上面，但目前就先留在這裡。

cues.en: Now I will write files, dot download, test, dot P and G.
cues.zh: 現在寫 files.download，test.png。

cues.en: Okay, so now I just run this code and that's downloading this file.
cues.zh: 好，執行後，就會下載這個檔案。

cues.en: And now you can see it's downloaded it onto my computer and now I can open it up here and have access to it.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，已經下載到我的電腦，可以在這裡開啟、使用它。

cues.en: So now we've stored a PNG file.
cues.zh: 現在儲存的是 PNG 檔，

cues.en: You can also save this as PDF just by changing the extension of this file.
cues.zh: 只要改變檔案副檔名，也可以存成 PDF。

cues.en: So I run the same code save fig with test pdf and now we see there's two files here that we've created test out PDF and PNG.
cues.zh: 用同樣的 savefig 程式碼，改成 test.pdf，就看到這裡建立了 test.pdf 與 PNG 兩個檔案。

cues.en: And actually when I clicked on this one, it just immediately downloaded it.
cues.zh: 其實我點這個的時候，它就直接下載了。

cues.en: So now again, you see we can keep zooming in and this is vector based graphics.
cues.zh: 現在再看，可以一直放大，這是向量圖，

cues.en: So the more I zoom in, it continues to look really nice and crisp.
cues.zh: 所以越放大，仍然維持漂亮、清晰。
